# asf component registry

<!-- Generated by scripts/registry-md.mjs from registry.json; edit the JSON, then rerun the script. -->

What the asf template covers, which reference screen each piece was drawn from, and what is still missing. Updated 2026-10-25.

When the reference design changes, compare the new screens with the ones listed here, then implement only the pieces whose screens changed and the entries under "Not built yet". Sources: design/screens/*.jpg: the org ERP admin panel (erp.asf.sh), personal data blurred; design/screens/public/*.jpg: the foundation site (assunnahfoundation.org).

## Foundations

| Part | Files | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Tokens | `src/theme/theme.ts`<br>`src/theme/shadows.ts` | Every colour, radius, spacing and font comes from src/ui/tokens.ts in the app; measured reference values are in design/tokens.measured.json. |
| Component styles | `src/theme/overrides.ts` | MUI defaults restyled from the reference screens: fields, tables, tabs, dialogs, menus, focus ring, selection, scrollbars, reduced motion. |
| Dark mode | `src/theme/theme.ts`<br>`src/components/shell/color-mode-button.tsx` | Follows the system until the user picks; the choice is remembered by MUI. |
| Bengali | `src/theme/theme.ts`<br>`src/components/ui-provider.tsx`<br>`src/components/labels.ts` | Noto Sans Bengali (OFL) after Public Sans for Bengali letters; every built-in word is a UiLabels entry. |
| Surfaces | `src/components/surface-context.ts` | admin (dark primary button, dense) and public (brand primary, roomier, solid fields on coloured bands). |
